items.name: さら
items.note: Indexes 盛; upper 成 is explained as historical sound material.

items.name: なる
items.note: Recognition/sound component inside 盛, not its dictionary indexing radical.

items.name: みず
items.note: Whole 水 indexing family in 泉; compare the left-side 氵 form learned in Hokkaido.

items.name: たくみ
items.note: Indexes 左 and distinguishes its lower component from 右.

items.name: にんべん
items.note: Shortened 人 on the left of 休; recognition bridge to earlier 木.

items.name: いち
items.note: Selected indexing family for 上 and 下.

items.name: ぼう
items.note: Selected indexing family for 中, with an enclosure crossed by a line.

items.name: ゆうべ
items.note: Selected indexing family for 外; its other visible piece is 卜.

items.name: ぼく
items.note: Recognition component on the right of 外; not a claim about the word's literal meaning.

items.name: ふしづくり
items.note: 巻 belongs to 卩 indexing in the selected reference; recognise its modern upper/lower shapes separately.

items.name: のぎへん
items.note: Selected indexing family for 私, next to 厶; learn わたし as a word.

items.name: ひとやね
items.note: Selected 人 family for 会, with an upper cover above 云-like material.

items.name: つち
items.note: Indexes 地 in supported 地図; 池's 氵 is a different left component.

items.name: すん
items.note: Selected indexing for 寺, 土-like upper shape above 寸.

items.name: うまへん
items.note: Selected indexing family of 駅, with 尺 on the right.

items.name: ごんべん
items.note: Selected indexing family; other modern pieces are recognition aids.

items.name: また
items.note: Selected indexing family; other modern pieces are recognition aids.
